newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER SIGN BRAZILIAN ZE ELIAS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER SIGN BRAZILIAN ZE ELIAS.

text.p: Inter Milan have continued their aggressive transfer campaign by signing Brazilian midfielder Ze Elias from German club Bayer Leverkusen, Italian newspapers reported on Saturday.
They said agents for the 20-year-old had signed a four-year deal late on Friday, with Inter paying Bayer 10 billion lire ($6 million) for the defensive midfielder.

Ze Elias will earn 1.5 billion lire ($900,000) per season and is seen as a replacement for England midfielder Paul Ince, whom newspapers say is close to signing for a premier league club, probably Liverpool.
The signing was just the latest in a series of big-name transfer deals sealed by Inter this summer.

The Milan club picked up Argentine midfielder Diego Simeone from Atletico Madrid last week after signing Brazilian prodigy Ronaldo from Barcelona in a multi-million dollar deal that must still be approved by FIFA.
Barcelona have refused to recognise the deal and soccer's world governing body is expected to make a pronouncement on the case soon.
